issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The new gobbi_bits function only reads SMILES strings. Its module-level cache is keyed by SMILES and holds features, not labels, so it cannot leak test labels between folds. It does no file or network access.

No bug that would make the result meaningless. The Gobbi 2D pharmacophore bits are folded modulo N_BITS. Some different bits will land on the same position, but that only affects feature quality, not whether the result is valid. A molecule with no on-bits gives an empty index array, which is handled without error. Tanimoto on binary vectors is still valid.

Recomputed z = (0.4774 - 0.4777) / (0.0070 * sqrt(1/1 + 1/1)) ≈ -0.030. This matches the harness value of -0.027 up to rounding of the reported means. With one run per side, the difference is well within noise.
Reject agrees with the numbers: the candidate shows no improvement over the incumbent, and it adds a dependency and slower feature generation.
